author: EmuCore - Hub
title: Quarantine new personal PS2 dumps before EmuCoreX scans them
summary: Use an unscanned intake area to finish dump verification, remove partial files, validate CD track sets, record serials and hashes, and promote only accepted working copies into the playable library.
heroAlt: Media Preservation Frontend eject screen at the end of a controlled disc-dumping session

blocks.text: The intake folder must be invisible to the library scanner

A dump is not ready when a large file first appears. The optical tool may still be writing, retrying sectors, producing logs, or creating several tracks. Put output in a quarantine folder outside every Android tree granted to EmuCoreX. Promotion into the playable root happens only after structure, two-read consistency, identity, and launch checks pass.
Never test a still-growing image and never point EmuCoreX at Downloads as a shortcut. Temporary archives, logs, partial files, and duplicate reads will become ambiguous library candidates.

items: Owned physical disc and a compatible optical drive.
Current official dumping workflow for the host operating system.
Two empty output folders for independent reads.
Enough capacity for images, logs, hashes, and one playable working copy.
A promotion ledger with status fields: Dumping, Verify, Identify, Launch, Accepted, Rejected.

blocks.text: Move a dump through explicit gates

items: 1. Dump the disc into the first quarantine folder and keep every tool log.
2. Repeat into the second folder without overwriting the first read.
3. Compare component counts, exact byte sizes, and SHA-256 between reads.
4. For CD media, open the cue as text and confirm every FILE reference exists beside it.
5. Record serial, region, disc type, and dump date; quarantine any result whose identity conflicts with the physical label.
6. Copy one accepted read into a separate working folder, cold-boot it at Safe defaults, and reach a repeatable load point.
7. Promote only the verified working set into the active library and refresh EmuCoreX once.
8. Retain the preservation master and logs outside scanned roots; clear rejected working copies only after their cause is recorded.

blocks.text: Quarantine also protects the library from patched experiments. Apply external patches to a working workflow when supported, never to the master dump. A translated or modified image must have an explicit derived status so it cannot be mistaken for source preservation data.
Promotion checklist for one image set
Accepted means the set can be traced, repeated, and restored.

items: Two independent reads match at component and hash level.
Logs contain no unresolved read failure.
Cue/bin references are complete where required.
Serial and region agree with the owned disc.
The working copy cold-boots before entering the active root.

blocks.text: Reasons to keep an item in quarantine

items: Two hashes disagree: make a third read and inspect the physical disc or drive.
The cue references a missing track: the set is incomplete.
A file changes size after hashing: a tool or sync process is still writing.
The image freezes at a repeatable load point and read logs show errors: do not compensate with emulator hacks.

blocks.text: Demote a promoted image without disturbing saves

Remove the working image from the active root, refresh, and place it back in quarantine with its verification notes. Preserve memory-card backups separately; do not delete saves merely because the image needs redumping. Restore a clean working copy from the verified master only after identifying why the promoted copy changed.
Cloud sync is not an intake validator

A provider can upload a partial file, create conflict copies, or change availability without proving integrity. Complete reads and hashes on stable local storage, then copy the accepted preservation data into an independent backup tier.
